title: Population
description: Who the tier-1 people are and how you come to know them (M2.6, D89, D91): their names, adult ages and whom they are drawn to, worked out from the seed and never stored; and the ties you keep with them. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

names.description: The names they are drawn from.

ages.description: Adult age bands and their shares, per thousand adults. Nobody is under 18 (D89).

drawn.description: Per age band, per thousand: drawn to their own gender, and to anyone (D91). The rest are drawn to the other.

chemistry.description: How drawn to you someone is, 0 to 100, when they can be: drawn from the seed for the pair, less points a year past the free years of age between you (tune).

ties.description: The people you know (D89): how many you keep, how many you meet an hour at a shared place, the hours together at which familiarity is half, and the share of an hour at work that counts (per hundred).

haunts.description: The third places you go out to.

carry.description: Per thousand people who use each set of pronouns, those whose bodies can carry a pregnancy (D96).
